info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Logistics Shipments Exceptions-v4-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Exception Retrieval API enables users to access detailed information regarding exceptions associated with logistics shipments. This endpoint allows developers to retrieve lists of exceptions, which can be critical for monitoring and managing shipment processes. Typical consumers include logistics coordinators and supply chain managers who need to identify and resolve issues affecting shipment delivery. The API supports efficient tracking and reporting of exceptions, improving overall operational efficiency in logistics management.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the list of exceptions related to shipments, providing insight into any issues or delays that may have arisen during shipping.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving exception information about shipments. This body allows the client to specify the desired parameters for the exception query in a JSON format.

200.description: The request was successful and shipment exceptions are returned.

ListLogisticsShipmentsExceptionsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to shipment exceptions. The body is expected to be a string.

ListLogisticsShipmentsExceptionsResponse.title: Shipments Exception Response

status.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique identifier for the shipment reference.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional information or message regarding the shipment status.

ListLogisticsShipmentsExceptionsResponse.description: Schema representing the response for a successful GET operation on shipments with potential exceptions.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created the shipment record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the shipment record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the shipment record was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing audit-related information for shipments.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
